title: answer with a tiered model stack (router): one free model, stronger model recorded not called
what: Atom (01:04 ET): until the first Gumroad sale Void stays on free models and a stronger model is recorded, not called; no second fallback stack. Supersedes the earlier records' Qwen 3.8 27B free tier, which is removed. Gemma 4 26B is the one free model (answers and fixes, on by default; VOID_ANSWER_MODELS=off turns it off). A hard ask goes to DeepSeek V4 Flash only when the earned budget is above zero AND an approved standing spend has room; otherwise Gemma answers and one 'would escalate' is counted in void_shortfalls (lib/shortfall.js from PR #1, the one evidence ledger the will and /api/earnings read). When Gemma itself fails, the same paid rule, else the open-web answer (fix: the rules). Worldtime added to the router's labelled set.
